title: Interwencje przyczynowe fizycznego powrotu kierownicy
question: Który kanał inicjuje trwałe antycentrowanie b3Wheel po jednoczesnym puszczeniu gazu i kierownicy: normalny kontakt, styczny kontakt czy wewnętrzne constrainty pojazdu?
hypothesis: Pojedyncze interwencje zastosowane dokładnie w chwili release, przy bitowo identycznym stanie pre-release, rozdzielą źródło antycentrowania bez zmiany shippingowej fizyki i bez sztucznego centrowania.

locked_factors.source_revision: one clean commit/tree with dirty=false provenance
locked_factors.pre_release_state: identical deterministic world state and byte-identical receipt immediately before drive=0 and steer=0
locked_factors.steering_inputs: boundary defects +0.45/-0.42 and adjacent return controls +0.44/-0.41
locked_factors.intervention_timing: exactly at simultaneous throttle and steering release
locked_factors.vehicle_geometry: unchanged M6 chassis, suspension, steering, wheel geometry, mass and inertia
locked_factors.solver_schedule: 60 Hz, four substeps, identical seed and case order
locked_factors.shipping_defaults: never written or changed by the probe
locked_factors.artificial_centering: forbidden: no centering spring, servo-to-zero or input-state-dependent torque

confounds: Changing more than one release intervention in a variant destroys causal attribution.
Rebuilding the world separately for each variant can produce different pre-release states; variants must fork from an identical receipt.
Disabling contact before release changes the acceleration and steering history and is not an admissible control.
Treating rack or coast controls as candidate fixes would confuse exclusion controls with product design.
A friction-zero result cannot by itself distinguish slip-force, pneumatic-trail absence or manifold geometry.
Constraint force and contact impulse channels are not independent additive torques and must not be double-counted.
A result on Linux headless is not Windows visual parity or owner-feel acceptance.
Tuning the tested steering amplitudes to obtain a green result would invalidate the frozen transition controls.

levels.rig: full native M6 headless probe forked from one frozen pre-release state
levels.purpose: Separate normal contact, tangential contact and internal-constraint contributions without modifying shipping physics.
levels.entry_gate: B3WHEEL-STEER-01 source-localization evidence exists; adapter proves identical pre-release receipts and one intervention per case.
levels.exit_gate: Two fresh processes are byte-identical; all variants preserve the receipt; result narrows the source and records negative controls plus explicit non-conclusions.

metrics: pre-release receipt SHA-256 and exact equality across all variants
steering angle, rack translation and sustained anti-centering onset
left/right spin-joint reaction torque and tie-rod moment about the live steering axes
contact normal/tangential impulse, centroid trail/scrub and loaded manifold topology
ball-joint twist/cone margins and first limit engagement
vehicle speed, yaw rate, lateral speed and wheel slip angle
repeatability hashes for summary and every raw trace
promotion_rules: Every variant changes only release_intervention and starts from the same byte-identical pre-release receipt.
Baseline must reproduce the published +0.45/-0.42 defects and +0.44/-0.41 returning controls before interventions are interpreted.
No-contact and friction-zero variants are diagnostic controls, never shipping candidates.
A source category may be selected only when two fresh runs agree byte-for-byte and adjacent controls remain interpretable.
The result must distinguish measured observations, causal inference and unresolved alternatives.
No core Box3D or shipping vehicle change may be included in C1.
The runner never chooses a product fix or marks owner feeling as accepted automatically.
manual_gates: Jozz reviews the causal conclusion and approves which minimal physical mechanism may be researched next.
Any later product candidate requires a native Windows build, visible debug geometry and manual feel validation without hidden assistance.
blockers: Implement a probe-only fork from one frozen pre-release state without rebuilding or re-driving each intervention variant.
Add an adapter that validates exact receipt equality, one intervention per case and immutable raw artifacts.
Define contact-disable and friction-zero interventions so they begin exactly at release and cannot leak into the pre-release trajectory.
Add red tests proving combinations, shipping-default writes and artificial centering are rejected.
Run two fresh deterministic matrices and seal a decision packet before any core/contact modification.
